title: The slot service dropped a held attempt before the capacity was declared again, so a journal failure or a crash between the record's removal and the declaration lost the declaration for good
resolution: Before the reclaim of a held attempt the service owes the declaration in the journal (oweCapacityDeclaration), which every later successful reclaim and every start journal through recordCapacity; slot and start tests with a journal failure and a crash fail before the fix.

title: After a durable reclaimFailed, a fault of the kill, the proof, or the release turned the reclaim into unavailable, so no reclaim-failed line was logged and no later reclaim finished the cleanup
resolution: Every outcome after the durable failure is reclaim-failed; a later reclaim, also after a restart, kills through ReclaimHost.killRecorded on Linux, proves the containment empty, and frees it without the program; tests of the three faults fail before the fix.

title: The three new start failures repeated the raw error message, which can name a checkout path that the credential redaction keeps
resolution: faultMessage gives a fixed message with only a system error code such as EACCES; a test of the line that workerMain writes for the hard-link read, the sweep, and the record read fails before the fix.

title: The adapter's handOffRecords had no direct test: worker tests replaced it with a fake and adapter tests called handedOff
resolution: Adapter tests read real records, also through a reopened adapter, reject a malformed and an unreadable record, and leave out one removed between the listing and its read; they fail against the code before handOffRecords and against mutants of each branch.

title: The scenario Reclaim after the exit refused every offer while a hand-off record existed, which contradicts Slot only on a macOS worker with several slots
resolution: The scenario now holds every slot of the worker, one of them by the handed-off attempt, as the architect's answer N2 keeps held slots counting on macOS.
